question: does ranking candidates by declared evidence quality change what the pipeline selects, without breaking the cases that already work?
heldConstant: ROMs, core, boot, masks, frame parameters and budgets. The only difference between arms is config.resourceSelection.
oracleDiscipline: read only after both arms committed for that cartridge; never an input to either arm; nothing tuned on it

rankingSpec.declaredBefore: committed in the commit that introduces this module, before any HOLDOUT seed or real cartridge was evaluated under ranked selection

criteria.question: was this address shown to change because of the action, against a frame-matched neutral control?
criteria.measured: the fraction of independent starts where the causal probe confirmed this address for its mask
criteria.whyThisWeight: a field that is not causally attributed cannot carry evidence about an action at all, so this is the prerequisite for every other criterion

criteria.question: does it move the same way from several independent starting states?
criteria.measured: the fraction of independent starts where the field moved, and whether the per-start step agreed
criteria.whyThisWeight: one trajectory is an anecdote; agreement across starts is the cheapest strong evidence available here

criteria.question: does it reach values that can carry information - more than one distinct value, a non-zero value, and a floor it settles at?
criteria.measured: distinct values observed, whether a non-zero value was reached, whether a floor was reached and held
criteria.whyThisWeight: a field pinned at one value cannot be measured against anything; this is what defeated every Life Force candidate in S8

criteria.question: is it distinguishable from a timer, from RNG, and from plain input echo?
criteria.measured: moved under the neutral control, how many different masks move it, whether its step is constant across starts
criteria.whyThisWeight: these three confounds are the documented failure modes of this pipeline (101 false attributions without shift control, 55 false typings without a neutral run), so they are weighted equal to reachability

criteria.question: did substituting the value change what the machine did next?
criteria.measured: the S4c downstream counterfactual, when a poke-capable driver and budget are available
criteria.whyThisWeight: deliberately below the four above: a null here is uninformative (read-modify-write and reads without visible effect both produce it), so it may raise a candidate but must not be able to sink one

criteria.question: does the behaviour survive a savestate restore, and does it still hold after a Start pulse?
criteria.measured: identical series after restore, and whether it still moves after a Start pulse
criteria.whyThisWeight: the game phase is itself an inference, so this guards against a candidate that exists only in one transient screen, but cannot outrank directly measurable evidence

rankingSpec.scoring: each criterion yields a score in [0,1] from its own measurement, is multiplied by its weight, and the weighted sum is divided by totalWeight. No criterion can veto another.
rankingSpec.selectionRuleWhenSeveralPass: the highest-ranked candidate by this spec that passed, with ties broken by tieBreak. NEVER the one whose outcome looks best, and never re-ranked after seeing outcomes.
forbidden: no address from an external source or a game document
no oracle label as an input to scoring
a downstream read is not proof of usefulness; its absence is not proof of no consumer
HOLDOUT must not be used to tune weights or to re-pick candidates after a failure
